verses.en: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
verses.pt: Livra-me, ó Senhor, dos homens maus; guarda-me dos homens violentos,
verses.en_web: Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man;
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> O Lord, take me out of the power of the evil man; keep me safe from the violent man:

verses.en: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
verses.pt: os quais maquinam maldades no coração; estão sempre projetando guerras.
verses.en_web: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
verses.en_bbe: For their hearts are full of evil designs; and they are ever making ready causes of war.

verses.en: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.
verses.pt: Aguçaram as línguas como a serpente; peçonha de áspides está debaixo dos seus lábios.
verses.en_web: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Their tongues are sharp like the tongue of a snake; the poison of snakes is under their lips. (Selah.)

verses.en: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
verses.pt: Guarda-me, ó Senhor, das mãos dos ímpios; preserva-me dos homens violentos, os quais planejaram transtornar os meus passos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, take me out of the hands of sinners; keep me safe from the violent man: for they are designing my downfall.

verses.en: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
verses.pt: Os soberbos armaram-me laços e cordas; estenderam uma rede à beira do caminho; puseram-me armadilhas.
verses.en_web: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: The men of pride have put secret cords for my feet; stretching nets in my way, so that they may take me with their tricks. (Selah.)

verses.en: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
verses.pt: Eu disse, ao Senhor: Tu és o meu Deus; dá ouvidos, ó Senhor, à voz das minhas súplicas.
verses.en_web: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: I have said to the Lord, You are my God: give ear, O Lord, to the voice of my prayer.

verses.en: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.pt: Ó Senhor, meu Senhor, meu forte libertador, tu cobriste a minha cabeça no dia da batalha.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord God, the strength of my salvation, you have been a cover over my head in the day of the fight.

verses.en: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.pt: Não concedas, ó Senhor, aos ímpios os seus desejos; não deixes ir por diante o seu mau propósito.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, give not the wrongdoer his desire; give him no help in his evil designs, or he may be uplifted in pride. (Selah.)

verses.en: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.pt: Não levantem a cabeça os que me cercam; cubra-os a maldade dos seus lábios.
verses.en_web: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.en_bbe: As for those who come round me, let their heads be covered by the evil of their lips.

verses.en: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.pt: Caiam sobre eles brasas vivas; sejam lançados em covas profundas, para que não se tornem a levantar!
verses.en_web: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
verses.en_bbe: Let burning flames come down on them: let them be put into the fire, and into deep waters, so that they may not get up again.

verses.en: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.pt: Não se estabeleça na terra o caluniador; o mal persiga o homem violento com golpe sobre golpe.
verses.en_web: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.en_bbe: Let not a man of evil tongue be safe on earth: let destruction overtake the violent man with blow on blow.

verses.en: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
verses.pt: Sei que o Senhor manterá a causa do aflito, e o direito do necessitado.
verses.en_web: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
verses.en_bbe: I am certain that the Lord will take care of the cause of the poor, and of the rights of those who are troubled.

verses.en: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
verses.pt: Decerto os justos louvarão o teu nome; os retos habitarão na tua presença.
verses.en_web: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, the upright will give praise to your name: the holy will have a place in your house.
